claims.claimText: KFUPM's AI+X page describes AI+X as an initiative designed to equip every undergraduate student with essential AI skills and says students begin with foundational AI coursework before their selected academic programs.
claims.claimValue: AI+X undergraduate AI coursework is described as broad undergraduate AI-skills preparation.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: AI+X is a comprehensive initiative designed to equip every undergraduate student with essential artificial intelligence (AI) skills, regardless of their chosen major. Students begin with foundational AI coursework before advancing into their selected academic programs, ensuring they gain firsthand exposure to AI applications that enhance their field of study.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: KFUPM describes AI+X as an initiative for every undergraduate student, with foundational AI coursework before selected academic programs.

claims.claimText: KFUPM's AI+X page says all undergraduate students are required to complete AI-focused coursework and states an institutional goal to graduate 10,000 AI-skilled professionals by 2030.
claims.claimValue: AI-focused coursework requirement and 2030 AI-skilled graduate goal stated on the AI+X page.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: By requiring all undergraduate students to complete AI-focused coursework, we aim to graduate 10,000 AI-skilled professionals by 2030, directly supporting Saudi Arabia’s vision and the goals set by the National Center for Artificial Intelligence.

claims.claimText: KFUPM's AI+X page states that KFUPM launched ChatGPT Edu in partnership with OpenAI and describes the initiative as integrating AI tools into classrooms and research environments.
claims.claimValue: ChatGPT Edu launch and classroom/research-environment integration stated by KFUPM.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: KFUPM is also the first university in Saudi Arabia to launch ChatGPT Edu in partnership with OpenAI. This initiative integrates AI tools into classrooms and research environments, enhancing research efforts and enabling students to focus on higher-level problem-solving and creativity.
